newsitem.title: USA: Perclose says U.S. FDA to grant review.
newsitem.headline: Perclose says U.S. FDA to grant review.

text.p: Perclose Inc said the U.S. Food and Drug Administration will grant an expedited pre-market approval review of its Prostar 9F and Prostar 11F percutaneous vascular surgical systems.
Previously, Perclose said it had submitted a 510k application, which included data from a 500 patient, randomized, multi-center clinical trial conducted under an investigational device exemption.
The company said it is now in the process of completing its pre-market approval submission for the Prostar devices.
The pre-market approval application will incorporate the same clinical data from the previously submitted 510k application.
